rows.name: Silver Hand Leader

records.label: any bandit boss at a radiant camp

target.source: user, 2026-11-13: the Silver Hand leaders 35; they take `Stats` from the bandit boss lists, so they need a level of their own

rows.note: alias `Boss` on `CRSilverHandNameChangerQuest` 09D6F6, `DisplayName` `SilverHandLeaderLabel` 09D6FB. The quest fills a Companions radiant camp's aliases with its bandits (`BanditFaction` 01BCC0, `ActorTypeNPC`), renames them "Silver Hand" (`SilverHandLabel` 087598) and its boss "Silver Hand Leader", and adds a Silver Sword 10AA19 and `LootSilverHand` potions, ingredients and books; their records, levels and outfits stay the bandits' (Bandits → *Bandit Chiefs*).

items: `LvlSilverhandBoss`: no other record keeps its own level (it takes `Stats` from `LvlBanditBoss`; the level belongs to the boss rungs on Bandits → *Bandit Chiefs*).

rows.note: the bandit boss rungs (6 · 10 · 16 · 21 · 28); only `Stats` is taken. Documented in full on Bandits → *Bandit Chiefs*.
